cc:Work.dc:title: Brass Birmingham — self-play PL strength
cc:Work.dc:description: Common-fit PL progression through generation 1340: 30 displayed points from 134 checkpoints (cap 30). Adjacent checkpoints averaged for display; first/latest remain exact. Recent detail covers generations 1140–1340: all 21 points exact, with a separate y-axis. Unmodified pointwise 95% setup-bootstrap intervals. Latest 694.650, interval [653.982, 738.365]. Paired change versus generation 1330: -83.630, 95% interval [-143.951, -38.832]. Latest slot: 128 games / 32 setups; Common fit: 17,152 games; 134 rated checkpoints. IL anchor 0; v4 reference 179.348.
